meta.title: Safwa Broast | Broast from Al Qafilah, Khamis Mushait. App coming soon
meta.description: Safwa Broast in Al Qafilah, Khamis Mushait. Our ordering app is coming soon to iPhone and Android: order, track your food to your door, and pay with mada, Apple Pay or cash.

hero.subtitle: The Safwa Broast app is almost here. Order from our Al Qafilah kitchen and follow it to your door.
hero.photoAlt: A pile of golden fried broast chicken

tracking.title: Watch it come to you.
tracking.body: The app follows your order live, from the fryer in Al Qafilah to your door. No more calling to ask where it is.

steps.title: On the way
steps.body: Your driver, live on the map.

tracking.screenAlt: Live tracking in the Safwa app: order #AS-8821 is on the way, with the driver on the map, 12 minutes left and the driver's details.

extras.title: The small stuff, sorted.
extras.body: Pickup or delivery, how you pay, where it goes. Set it once and the app remembers.
extras.screenAlt: Home screen of the Safwa app with food categories and the Family Broast Meal offer

footer.ctaBody: Launching soon on iPhone and Android. Until then, you know where to find us.
footer.tagline: Broast from Al Qafilah, Khamis Mushait.
footer.address: Opp. Husam Medical Clinic, Nasr Addin Al Tusi Street, Al Qafilah, Khamis Mushait
